tools.name: evobulut_list_customers
tools.description: List customer, supplier and contact cards (cari) with an optional text search. Evobulut API: POST /cari/base, cmd jq_list. Use an item's id with evobulut_get_customer.

tools.name: evobulut_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer card (cari) by id: name, tax data, addresses and contact fields. Evobulut API: POST /cari/base, cmd sql.

tools.name: evobulut_create_customer
tools.description: Create a company card (Firma Ekleme): name, tax office and tax number, with an optional code and related person. Creates a record and returns its new id; nothing is deleted. Evobulut API: POST /Firma/base, cmd ins.

tools.name: evobulut_list_stock
tools.description: List stock items (products and services) with an optional text search, code, name and prices. Evobulut API: POST /stok/base, cmd jq_list.

tools.name: evobulut_get_stock
tools.description: Get one stock item by id: code, name, prices, VAT rates, units and barcodes. Evobulut API: POST /stok/base, cmd sql.

tools.name: evobulut_get_stock_by_warehouse
tools.description: Get the stock quantity of one item in each warehouse. Evobulut API: POST /stok/base, cmd sql_stok_depo.

tools.name: evobulut_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices by text, customer and invoice date range. document_type is the vendor's document type code (optional, no filter when empty). Evobulut API: POST /fatura/base, cmd jq_list.

tools.name: evobulut_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id: header, customer, dates, totals and lines. Evobulut API: POST /fatura/base, cmd sql (sql_id).

tools.name: evobulut_list_invoice_payments
tools.description: List the payments (tahsilat) applied to one invoice. Evobulut API: POST /fatura/base, cmd kapama_list (gg_id).

tools.name: evobulut_list_quotes
tools.description: List quotes (teklif) by text, customer and date range. document_type defaults to 61, the given-quote type in the vendor sample. Evobulut API: POST /Teklif/base, cmd jq_list.

tools.name: evobulut_get_quote
tools.description: Get one quote by id: header, customer, totals and lines. Evobulut API: POST /Teklif/base, cmd sql.

tools.name: evobulut_list_orders
tools.description: List orders (sipariş) by text, customer, date range, and open or partly delivered status. document_type defaults to 51, the type in the vendor sample. Evobulut API: POST /Siparis/base, cmd jq_list.

tools.name: evobulut_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks (görev) for one assigned user id. Evobulut API: POST /Gorevler/base, cmd jq_list.

tools.name: evobulut_create_task
tools.description: Create a task (görev) for an Evobulut user, with a due date. The start date is today. Creates a record; nothing is deleted. Evobulut API: POST /Gorevler/base, cmd gorev_ins.

tools.name: evobulut_list_leads
tools.description: List leads (potansiyel müşteri) by text and date range. Evobulut API: POST /Potansiyel/base, cmd jq_list.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: evobulut_list_customers, evobulut_get_customer, evobulut_list_stock, evobulut_get_stock, evobulut_get_stock_by_warehouse, evobulut_list_invoices, evobulut_get_invoice, evobulut_list_invoice_payments, evobulut_list_quotes, evobulut_get_quote, evobulut_list_orders, evobulut_list_tasks, evobulut_list_leads · Private data: evobulut_list_customers, evobulut_get_customer, evobulut_create_customer, evobulut_list_invoices, evobulut_create_task · Public sink: evobulut_list_customers, evobulut_get_customer, evobulut_create_customer, evobulut_list_stock, evobulut_get_stock, evobulut_get_stock_by_warehouse, evobulut_list_invoices, evobulut_get_invoice, evobulut_list_invoice_payments, evobulut_list_quotes, evobulut_get_quote, evobulut_list_orders, evobulut_list_tasks, evobulut_create_task, evobulut_list_leads.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: evobulut_list_customers, evobulut_get_customer, evobulut_list_stock, evobulut_get_stock, evobulut_get_stock_by_warehouse, evobulut_list_invoices, evobulut_get_invoice, evobulut_list_invoice_payments, evobulut_list_quotes, evobulut_get_quote, evobulut_list_orders, evobulut_list_tasks, evobulut_list_leads · Private data: evobulut_list_customers, evobulut_get_customer, evobulut_create_customer, evobulut_list_invoices, evobulut_create_task · Public sink: evobulut_list_customers, evobulut_get_customer, evobulut_create_customer, evobulut_list_stock, evobulut_get_stock, evobulut_get_stock_by_warehouse, evobulut_list_invoices, evobulut_get_invoice, evobulut_list_invoice_payments, evobulut_list_quotes, evobulut_get_quote, evobulut_list_orders, evobulut_list_tasks, evobulut_create_task, evobulut_list_leads

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
